assumptions.choice: Compute stop distance and position size at signal time using the current bar's close price (the actual fill price is unknown until the next bar executes the market order)
assumptions.reason: spec requires sizing 'computed from stop distance' but does not specify which price to use before the order fills; the real executed price is used afterward to place the actual protective stop/take-profit orders

assumptions.choice: Added a use_take_profit boolean parameter, defaulted to True
assumptions.reason: spec calls the take-profit 'optional' while also giving a concrete default (2.0%), so it is implemented as always-on by default but exposed as a togglable, configurable parameter

assumptions.choice: Round the risk-based size down to a whole number of shares and skip the entry if the computed size is less than 1
assumptions.reason: spec is silent on fractional shares for an equity strategy; whole-share sizing is the standard convention and avoids invalid fractional orders

assumptions.choice: Manually cancel the take-profit order when the stop-loss fills and vice versa, tracked via explicit order references in notify_order, instead of using backtrader's built-in oco order parameter
assumptions.reason: keeps the one-cancels-other bracket behavior explicit and auditable rather than relying on undocumented library-internal OCO semantics

assumptions.choice: Cancel any live stop-loss/take-profit orders before submitting a signal-driven close(), and only allow a new opposite-direction entry once flat on a later bar
assumptions.reason: implements 'cancel/replace stops on position changes' and 'one position at a time' without an explicit reversal rule, which the spec does not state
